title: Luminous Grain
description: Un style d'illustration numérique minimaliste défini par des silhouettes nettes illuminées par des dégradés vibrants sur un fond noir absolu. Un grain de pointillé dense et uniforme recouvre l'image, apportant une texture tactile façon risographie aux contours vectoriels.
description_en: A minimalist digital illustration style defined by razor-sharp silhouettes illuminated by vibrant, smooth gradients against a stark, pitch-black void. Heavy, uniform stipple grain overlays the entire image, giving a tactile, risograph-like texture to the pristine vector contours.
description_fr: Un style d'illustration numérique minimaliste défini par des silhouettes nettes illuminées par des dégradés vibrants sur un fond noir absolu. Un grain de pointillé dense et uniforme recouvre l'image, apportant une texture tactile façon risographie aux contours vectoriels.
prompt: Minimalist digital gradient illustration characterized by heavy stipple noise and stark figure-ground contrast. Apply this style to the complete scene described by {{subject}}, preserving its factual content, camera angle, framing, spatial layout, and stated exclusions. The image must occupy the absolute entire dedicated space as a canvas rule: no borders, no frames, no white margins, no canvas edges, full bleed to all four corners. The visual execution relies on extreme, stylized chiaroscuro, where the scene emerges dramatically from a pure, flat, pitch-black void. Forms and structures are defined entirely by razor-sharp, precision-cut outer silhouettes that contain impossibly smooth, luminous internal color gradients. There is absolutely no visible linework, hatching, or brushwork; volume and spatial depth are suggested solely through the buttery, seamless transition of intense light rolling into absolute shadow. The lighting behaves like a vibrant, neon-like wash, utilizing a {{primary_color}} base that smoothly shifts into vivid {{accent_color}} highlights, eventually fading into deep {{secondary_color}} midtones before disappearing completely into the crushing black background. A dense, uniform layer of monochromatic digital film grain and stipple noise is applied universally across both the brilliantly illuminated forms and the dark void, creating a cohesive, matte, tactile materiality reminiscent of modern risograph printing. Edges against the dark background remain perfectly crisp, pristine, and unfeathered, contrasting sharply with the soft, glowing internal light falloff. video.motion: Internal gradients should shift and pulse slowly, simulating moving light sources rolling across stationary geometric volumes. Silhouettes remain rigidly fixed while the light smoothly transitions across their surfaces.
video.camera: A completely static camera, treating the composition as a flat, moving poster rather than a navigable 3D space.
video.temporal_texture: The heavy stipple grain must boil rapidly and uniformly across the entire frame, while the crisp outer edges of the silhouettes remain perfectly stable and anti-aliased.
video.avoid: Avoid any 3D camera rotation, soft or blurry outer edges, realistic textures, or changes to the pitch-black void.
